src: colored pixels in the "mouth" of "Y-shaped" sprite
path: straight line in direction pointed by the convex part (tail) on the other side of the same "Y-shaped" sprite
dst: stack onto tail or onto other colored pixels already stacked
trajectory: ignore colored pixels stacked out of grid
src2: colored pixels not in the "mouth" of "Y-shaped" sprite
multi_step: move orange pixels to sprite tail one by one
